verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference API provider. A built-in assistant in its console is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The API playground is a request-testing tool, and connecting Claude Code or Codex means plugging external agents into its API; both are adjacent features or user-side arrangements, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
